overall_notes: The paper focuses on section-level biomedical text simplification and PLS section alignment/dataset creation rather than NLG evaluation. The NLG aspect is derived from enabling future simplification models to use their created dataset. Human evaluation was primarily for section labeling quality assessment rather than simplification output evaluation.
